$comment: Every local variable in the UI Kit, read with use_figma. First read on 2026-10-26, after the freeze; read again on 2026-10-30, after Rost's light values (registry/light.json) and the motion variables went into Figma. A value starting with @ is an alias to another variable. theme has two modes, dark (Rost's default) and light; base has one. On 2026-10-31, 21 values changed in Figma to pass WCAG 2.1 AA (docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md says which and why), and the same 21 here. Also on 2026-10-31, 431 component variables went into the theme collection, one family per interactive component, each an alias of the semantic variable it replaced; they are here too. bin/build-tokens.mjs builds tokens/ from this.
